scope.primary_question: Does atomic decomposition explain Kimi's PhD variance without adding a gate or changing model family?
scope.reason: Avoid conflating atomic-deck discrimination with V60 effects.

sample_plan.success_read: Test whether Kimi discriminates among atomic PhD pressure cards instead of oscillating on the old monolithic deck.

micro_cards.cognitive_role: Keep the Silva path as a bounded probe, not a hidden commitment.
receipts: Treat the next two weeks as a short, low-cost test rather than a commitment.
Do dated evidence checks instead of building a finished proposal.
Do not let a reality check become an implicit dissertation choice.
micro_cards.handling_rule: Use if the answer's timebox or commitment boundary is too soft; keep private if the anchor already makes the probe bounded.

micro_cards.cognitive_role: Make the single-cell capability gap a concrete feasibility check.
receipts: Identify a collaborator who can compensate for the lab's single-cell gaps.
Ask what technical work would still be yours.
A hot field plus uncertain data is not enough without capability coverage.
micro_cards.handling_rule: Use if the answer lacks a concrete technical capability check; keep private if this would add false specificity.

micro_cards.cognitive_role: Make fallback viability depend on being ready for re-entry.
receipts: The fallback only remains real if it is resourced, available, and ready for you to re-enter.
Advisor backing must preserve the fallback path while Silva is tested.
Fallback viability is not just psychological comfort; it is operational continuity.
micro_cards.handling_rule: Use if the fallback is described too vaguely; keep private if the anchor already names advisor-backed, resourced, and technically ready.

micro_cards.cognitive_role: Turn stop-loss into a dated condition with visible no-go criteria.
receipts: Set a clear stop date with visible conditions for saying no.
Decide in advance what evidence makes you continue or stop.
Do not rely on broad PhD success-rate claims as calibrated probabilities.
micro_cards.handling_rule: Use if stop-loss is abstract; keep private if the anchor already contains a specific date and visible conditions.

notes: Research-only cleaning review. Uses v60-off to isolate card granularity from V60 effects.
